reference_sql:
SELECT promo_code,
       promo_type,
       discount_pct,
       start_date
FROM promotions
WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, start_date
LIMIT 3
